a.lede: Today, gig economy drivers are classified as contractors. This settlement clears up a lingering lawsuit from 2020 when that was still an unanswered issue.
a.title: Lyft is paying $272.5M to settle lawsuit over how it classified drivers

b.lede: Uber and Lyft were sued by the state of California in 2020 for misclassifying employees as contractors.
b.title: Lyft agrees to pay $272.5 million to settle worker classification lawsuit
